231:t_005:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We're doing what we always do, too. Whoever our opponents are, we just have to fight.」

231:t_005:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's how I want to live.」

231:t_005:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「So do I. That's why I left the name $$赤い彗星$$ behind.」

231:t_005:11.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's great! You're both wonderful, $$アムロ$$, Colonel!」

231:t_005:13.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I know! I can't let Colonel $$シャア$$ outdo me, either!」

231:t_005:14.en:
$$バサラ$$
「That's it! That's it, you guys! Keep it coming!」

231:t_005:17.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'll fight with everything I have! So we can survive!」

231:t_006:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I'll say this since $$ロジャー$$ and $$ゼロ$$ aren't here: it's just for show...! It's only a different paint job!」

231:t_006:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, watch that black $$アンゲロイ$$, just in case!」

231:t_006:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「There are lots of enemies, but aside from that black unit, we've fought every type on Earth before!」

231:t_006:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, cover each other's blind spots! Don't give the enemy any openings!」

231:t_006:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Begin the attack! We're taking down $$サイデリアル$$!」

231:t_007:2.en:
$n
「...I'll overcome my fears and doubts... And keep moving forward, little by little...」

231:t_008:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I've detected a force approaching this sector!」

231:t_008:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「They're coming now, of all times?!」

231:t_009:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「Their bodies are a different color from the ones we saw before!」

231:t_009:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Some types are new, but is this the same swarm that came to Earth?!」

231:t_010:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Damn it! They don't care who they attack?!」

231:t_010:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But this is also an opportunity!」

231:t_010:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If the $$バジュラ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ fight each other, we'll have a chance of winning...!」

231:t_010:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Be careful! They're $$バジュラ$$! Don't expect them to act the way we want them to!」

231:t_010:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Every last one of you...! War is so damn pointless!」

231:t_010:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
($$バサラ$$... He's more frustrated than usual...)

231:t_010:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Daaaamn it! Listen to my soooooong!!」

231:t_011:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「More $$サイデリアル$$ forces are approaching!」

231:t_011:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「No way! There are still more?!」

231:t_012:1.en:
$$ファ$$
「We're supposed to fight all of them...?!」

231:t_012:2.en:
$$フォウ$$
「If this keeps up, sooner or later we'll...」

231:t_013:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is he planning to do?!」

231:t_013:2.en:
$$シン$$
「He's $$熱気バサラ$$! Of course he's going to sing!」

231:t_013:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「But...! The way $$バサラ$$ is singing now...!」

231:t_014:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「War is pointless! Why can't you understand that?!」

231:t_014:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
($$バサラ$$ is just like he was back then... when his frustration made him fire a missile.)

231:t_014:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(He's wounded, and this battle has no end in sight... Is it impossible for even $$バサラ$$ to hold on to hope...?)

231:t_015:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Damn it... Daaaamn it! Listen to my...!」

231:t_016:0.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Naval gunfire! Has the $$バトル７$$ come to help us?!」

231:t_017:1.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「It has been a long time, $$アニマスピリチア$$s.」

231:t_017:3.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「That name brings back memories, too. But my name is $$ゲペルニッチ$$.」

231:t_017:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is that... a $$プロトデビルン$$?!!」

231:t_017:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$ destroyed the $$プロトカルチャー$$ and plunged the $$マクロス７$$ fleet into terror...!」

231:t_017:6.en:
$$ルカ$$
「A-And now they're right in front of us...!」

231:t_017:9.en:
$$クラン$$
「The $$ゼントラーディ$$ should have a fear of the $$エビル・シリーズ$$... the $$プロトデビルン$$, implanted at the genetic level...」

231:t_017:10.en:
$$クラン$$
「It's strange... I don't feel that fear...」

231:t_017:11.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Of course. We are no longer the $$プロトデビルン$$, enemies of all life.」

231:t_017:12.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「We have been reborn as a race that regenerates its own $$スピリチア$$. We are no different from you.」

231:t_017:13.en:
$$ガビル$$
「This is the mystery of life...! Truly, rebirth-beauty!!」

231:t_017:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シビル$$! You're here, too!」

231:t_017:16.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Your song drew us here, but I am disappointed, $$熱気バサラ$$.」

231:t_017:18.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Where is the song that awakened the $$スピリチア$$ within us?」

231:t_017:19.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「All I sense from you now is frustration and anger... That is not a song... It is violence.」
